elements.title: a hypothesized land bridge (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that a hypothesized land bridge may have allowed some fish species (example pictured) to migrate from South America to Cuba?

elements.title: Ken Battle (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that a Sunday afternoon phone call to Ken Battle laid the foundations for the Canadian Child Benefit program?

elements.title: Pem Nem (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that in the narrative epic Pem Nem, the union of two lovers is a metaphor for the union of the soul with God?

elements.title: Jane Stuart Smith (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that after becoming a born again Christian, soprano Jane Stuart Smith abandoned a successful opera career to pursue a life of service?

elements.title: first R-rated play (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that Singapore's first R-rated play was performed despite the police finding parts of it "offensive"?

elements.title: Tilaluha (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that the Filipino boy band SB19 considered disbandment after their debut single "Tilaluha" saw little success?

elements.title: Richard Stratton (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that Richard Stratton's diplomatic career took him "from South America to Japan, and from Southern Africa to the foothills of the Himalayas"?

elements.title: among the millions of prisoners of war murdered by the Germans during WWII (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that among the millions of prisoners of war murdered by the Germans during WWII there were also tens of thousands of their former allies, the Italians?

elements.title: Noah Knigga (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that American football player Noah Knigga went viral for his last name and had to clarify its pronunciation?
